provenance.formula_source: standard paraxial Gaussian-beam optics (Siegman, 'Lasers', eq. 17.14); EPOCH's gauss(x,x0,w)=exp(-((x-x0)/w)^2) confirmed at code/epoch/epoch1d/src/parser/evaluator_blocks.F90:974-977

policy.shape: Time-averaged (>=1.5 laser periods) transverse Ey^2 second-moment waist at the boundary column vs analytic w_bnd = w_0*sqrt(1+(x_spot/x_R)^2). A separate, phase-sensitive least-squares fit (added by the independent Sol review of PR338's repair pass, since squaring for the waist removes phase entirely) recovers the quadratic focal-curvature phase difference phi(y=+-2 micron)-phi(y=0) and compares it to the analytic 2*pi/lambda0*y^2/(2*RC) prediction.
policy.tolerance_origin: Waist: 20% relative, covering finite-window temporal-averaging bias and coarse-grid second-moment estimation error, not a physics-accuracy claim. Phase: PHASE_DIFF_TOL=3x the analytic prediction (a least-squares fit over a short, coarsely-sampled window is considerably noisier than the amplitude fit), PHASE_NONTRIVIAL_FLOOR=0.3x (rejects an absent curvature), PHASE_SYMMETRY_TOL=0.5x (the +-y difference must also be symmetric, independent of RC's exact value).
policy.determinism: No particles/injectors; single rank; fully deterministic.

criteria.name: focal_phase_curvature_nontrivial
criteria.rule: |phase(y=+2um)-phase(y=0)| >= 0.3x the analytic curvature prediction, both sides

criteria.name: focal_phase_curvature_magnitude
criteria.rule: |measured phase diff - analytic phase diff| <= 3x the analytic phase diff, both sides

criteria.name: focal_phase_curvature_symmetry
criteria.rule: |phase(+2um)-phase(0) - (phase(-2um)-phase(0))| <= 0.5x the analytic phase diff, both sides
